script.text: Jaden confronted Professor Viper on a precarious platform reaching high into the sky. Jaden wanted answers about the BioBands and challenged Viper to a duel.
Welcome, friends. Glad you could join me.
Viper, it's time to end all of this! Too many people have gotten hurt already!
That’s right! Turn off these BioBands!
Rest easy, my dear. It will all be over soon. But first, I need one more thing from you. Jaden, with your assistance, I will complete my mission to resurrect a great power!
I'm not helping you with anything! Got that?
Don’t you see? You’re all mine now, Jaden! Look around! There’s no escape! The only way down is for you to defeat me!
It’s not fair! You already put Jaden through the wringer! Let him gain all his strength back and then you can duel him! Ya big bully!
I'll duel him! I've taken down bigger!
Hmph. You're not worth the time or the effort. The one I want is Jaden Yuki! He's the only one I'll duel!
Oh yeah? Then we got something in common because you're the only one that I want to duel! Looks to me like it's time to get your game on, Viper!
I'm so pleased, Jaden. I'm sure I won't be dissapointed.
